content: Got ni Ir e re tagagiyeg Nth’abi Tolang

content.text: I SOMOL e pilung! Fayleng, mu felfelan’!
Ngam felfelan’gad e pi donguch u lan e day!
Manileng nge lumor nib dub’ag e ba liyeg;
be gagiyeg nib mat’aw ma ba yal’uw.
Nifiy e be yan nib m’on rok
nge urfiy e pi to’ogor rok ni kar liyeged.
Uluch rok e be gal’ e fayleng;
me guy e fayleng me t’on.
Pi yochi burey e ranran ni bod e wax u p’eowchen SOMOL,
u p’eowchen fare Somol ko fayleng ni polo’.
Tharmiy e be weliy feni mat’aw SOMOL,
ma gubin e pi nam ni yad be guy feni maluplup’.
Ra tamra’ urngin e pi’in yad ma tayfan e pi liyos;
gubin e got ni yad ra siro’ u p’eowchen SOMOL.
Ke felan’ e girdi’ nu Zion,
nge pi binaw nu Judah e yad be felfelan’
ni bochan e tin ka mu tirigiliy, I gur SOMOL.
SOMOL ni Gubin ma Rayag Rok, gur e tagagiyeg ko fayleng ni polo’;
ga ba ga’ ngak gubin e got.
I SOMOL e bt’uf rok e pi’in nib fananikay e kireb;
mma ayuweg e yafos rok e girdi’ rok;
ma chuwegrad u lan pa’ e pi’in kireb.
Tamilang e be mat’ nga daken e pi’in bmat’aw,
ma be felfelan’ e pi’in ba yal’uw gumircha’rad.
Gimed urngin e pi’in gimed bmat’aw e nge felanmed
ni bochan e n’en nike rin’ SOMOL!
Mu leam niged e n’en ke rin’ Got nib thothup,
mi gimed pining e magaer ngak.
